title: VeriOpt: PPA-Aware High-Quality Verilog Generation via Multi-Role LLMs
problem: LLM-generated Verilog prioritizes functional correctness while ignoring Power-Performance-Area (PPA) metrics critical for industrial designs.
method: Role-based multi-LLM framework with specialized roles (Planner, Programmer, Reviewer, Evaluator) integrated with PPA-aware prompting and multi-modal feedback from synthesis reports.
key_novelty: First PPA-aware LLM framework using role-based prompting and synthesis feedback for high-quality RTL generation.
contributions: Role-based multi-agent prompting emulating human design workflows
Multi-modal feedback integration from synthesis tools
88% power, 76% area, 73% timing improvement over baseline LLM
